teaser: What does a life spent giving away compassion look like when the hands doing the giving want everything filed, labeled, and running on schedule? You are a 9, asked to let go of outcomes you cannot control, and an ESTJ, built to secure outcomes you can. The crossing is not a contradiction so much as a standing argument: the wide, unbounded care this number points toward, held inside four letters that measure care in action items and follow-through. At an airport gate you are the one who finds the gate agent, gets the elderly passenger rebooked, and still feels, boarding, that it was not quite enough.
excerpt: Four missed calls sit on the phone before you notice, because you were in a used bookshop finding the exact edition someone mentioned wanting months ago.
